svg.aria-label: Dusk on a dense Punland high street: a friendly lanky ginger cat in a blue hoodie waves outside The Three Crows, a big leaning Victorian corner pub that runs out of frame, its door a head taller than him; a side street recedes past string lights to distant towers and a crane; crows perch on the pub sign and a crooked lamp post; railings guard the stairs down to The Holding Pen, live music below
